sets.notes: The Pummerin hangs in the north tower of the Stephansdom. Rankings vary: since 2016 the c. 25-tonne bell of the People's Salvation Cathedral in Bucharest is heavier than both the Petersglocke and the Pummerin, so the card's 'second-largest' reflects the traditional ranking (Petersglocke first, Pummerin second).

sets.notes: Open-list questions: for the original, any three of the twelve animals (Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, Pig) are correct; likewise any three of the five phases (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water), any three lunar-calendar festivals (also e.g. Lantern Festival, Qingming) and any three Western signs.
